basis: Sale consideration (COLLECTION.md s1, Erik 2026-09-22): IDEXX bought Blue Ridge Pharmaceuticals on 1998-10-01 for cash, notes, warrants on 805,519 IDEXX shares allocated among the Blue Ridge stockholders, and up to 1,240,875 contingent IDEXX shares, and its 8-K's stock purchase agreement names Sutter Hill Ventures, a California Limited Partnership, and Sutter Hill Associates as Blue Ridge stockholders. The firm's 1999 table lists Blue Ridge ('Acquired by IDEXX') beside IDEXX ('Public company'); IDEXX is one of only two acquirers the table also lists as holdings (Avid is the other). No record ties SHV to IDEXX's own financing: its 1997 10-K and proxy do not name Sutter Hill, and press on IDEXX's founding names Venrock. The investment is Blue Ridge Pharmaceuticals (its own row, blue-ridge-pharmaceuticals). Medium: an early IDEXX round before its 1991 IPO cannot be excluded from the filings on EDGAR.

Sale consideration (COLLECTION.md s1, Erik 2026-09-22): the firm's 1999 table lists Digidesign ('Acquired by Avid') and Avid ('Public company'); Avid bought Digidesign, public since December 1993, in an all-stock merger in January 1995 (about $200M), so SHV's Digidesign shares became Avid shares. The same table's only other acquirer listed as a holding, IDEXX, is proven consideration (IDEXX's 1998 8-K names SHV as a Blue Ridge stockholder paid in IDEXX warrants and shares), so the table's acquirer rows record consideration, not investments. No record ties SHV to an Avid financing: Avid's 1996 10-K and 1997 proxy do not name Sutter Hill, and its 1993 IPO prospectus predates EDGAR. The investment is Digidesign (its own row, digidesign). Medium: a pre-IPO Avid round cannot be excluded without that prospectus.
